entities.name: NR Sidelink Discovery Procedure
entities.description: Procedure used by a UE supporting NR sidelink U2N Remote UE operation to evaluate AS layer conditions for receiving/transmitting NR sidelink discovery messages.

entities.name: UE supporting NR sidelink U2N Remote UE operation
entities.description: UE that supports NR sidelink U2N Remote UE operation and is configured by upper layers.

entities.name: NR Sidelink Discovery Message
entities.description: Discovery message transmitted or received over NR sidelink.

entities.name: AS layer conditions evaluation
entities.description: Evaluation of Access Stratum layer conditions for sidelink communication.

relations.description: The procedure requires a UE that supports NR sidelink U2N Remote UE operation.
The procedure involves receiving/transmitting NR sidelink discovery messages.
The procedure is used to evaluate AS layer conditions.
